propositions: rebar must support self-hosted Jira Data Center which differs from Cloud on REST API version (v2 vs v3), authentication (PAT vs ACLI), user identity model (name vs accountId), and text encoding (wiki/plain vs ADF)

the shared Jira family layer must consolidate duplicated field maps and sanitizers from Cloud adapter into single implementations consumed by both Cloud and DC backends via dependency inversion, not file relocation
DC backend requires HTTPS by default with explicit allow_insecure override and never disables certificate verification, consuming ca_bundle and resolved_statuses config keys
the DC transport must be gated behind a [jira-datacenter] optional dependency to preserve the engine's clean-core contract and keep the Cloud path untouched

bidirectional reconciliation against DC must be demonstrated live against a real Jira 8.17.1 instance with both inbound (DC issue → local store) and outbound (local edit → DC issue) data movement proven end to end
